mapper.select: SELECT id,login_name,password_hash,status,role,mfa_secret_ciphertext,auth_version FROM admin_accounts WHERE login_name=#{loginName}
SELECT id,login_name,password_hash,status,role,mfa_secret_ciphertext,auth_version FROM admin_accounts WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT count(*)::int FROM admin_accounts
SELECT id,admin_id,expires_at,consumed_at,failed_attempts FROM admin_login_challenges WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT a.id,a.login_name,a.password_hash,a.status,a.role,a.mfa_secret_ciphertext,a.auth_version FROM admin_accounts a JOIN admin_login_challenges c ON c.admin_id=a.id WHERE c.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_login_challenges SET failed_attempts=failed_attempts+1,consumed_at=CASE WHEN failed_attempts+1>=5 THEN #{now} ELSE consumed_at END WHERE id=#{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL
UPDATE admin_login_challenges SET consumed_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at>#{now} AND failed_attempts<5
mapper.select: SELECT s.admin_id,a.role,a.auth_version,s.expires_at,s.revoked_at FROM admin_sessions s JOIN admin_accounts a ON a.id=s.admin_id WHERE s.token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND s.expires_at>#{now} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND a.status='active'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE id=#{id} AND status='visible' AND scope='public' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND expires_at>#{now})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON p.id=c.post_id WHERE c.id=#{id} AND c.status='visible' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.expires_at>#{now} AND p.status='visible' AND p.scope='public' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.expires_at>#{now})
SELECT request_hash,resource_id,expires_at FROM idempotency_records WHERE actor_key=#{actor} AND method='POST' AND route_key='/v1/reports' AND key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_records(actor_key,method,route_key,key,request_hash,status,resource_type,resource_id,response_code,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(#{actor},'POST','/v1/reports',#{key},#{hash},'completed','report',#{id},201,#{now},#{now},#{expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT(actor_key,method,route_key,key) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_records SET status='completed',updated_at=#{now} WHERE actor_key=#{actor} AND method='POST' AND route_key='/v1/reports' AND key=#{key} AND status='pending'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reports(id,reporter_principal_id,target_type,post_id,comment_id,reason_code,detail,status,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{reporter},#{targetType},CASE WHEN #{targetType}='post' THEN #{targetId} END,CASE WHEN #{targetType}='comment' THEN #{targetId} END,#{reasonCode},#{detail},'open',1,#{now},#{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id,reporter_principal_id,target_type,COALESCE(post_id,comment_id) AS target_id,reason_code,detail,status,version,created_at FROM reports WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id,reporter_principal_id,target_type,COALESCE(post_id,comment_id) AS target_id,reason_code,detail,status,version,created_at FROM reports WHERE id=#{id} AND reporter_principal_id=#{reporter}

SELECT id,reporter_principal_id,target_type,COALESCE(post_id,comment_id) AS target_id,reason_code,detail,status,version,created_at FROM reports WHERE reporter_principal_id=#{reporter} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT id,reporter_principal_id,target_type,COALESCE(post_id,comment_id) AS target_id,reason_code,detail,status,version,created_at FROM reports status=#{status} ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'open' THEN 0 WHEN 'reviewing' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,created_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id,reporter_principal_id,target_type,COALESCE(post_id,comment_id) AS target_id,reason_code,detail,status,version,created_at FROM reports WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET status='resolved',resolved_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('open','reviewing')
mapper.select: SELECT target_type,target_id,status,version,pending_since,title,body FROM (SELECT 'post'::text AS target_type,id AS target_id,status,version,updated_at AS pending_since,title,body FROM posts WHERE status=#{status} AND status IN ('pending','rejected','visible','hidden') AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (status IN ('pending','rejected') OR expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) UNION ALL SELECT 'comment'::text AS target_type,c.id AS target_id,c.status,c.version,c.updated_at AS pending_since,NULL::text AS title,c.body FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON p.id=c.post_id WHERE c.status=#{status} AND c.status IN ('pending','rejected','visible','hidden') AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.scope='public' AND p.status='visible' AND p.expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (c.status IN ('pending','rejected') OR c.expires_at IS NULL OR c.expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) q ORDER BY pending_since,target_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.object_key FROM media_assets m JOIN media_variants v ON v.media_id=m.id AND v.kind='display' WHERE m.id=#{mediaId} AND m.status='approved' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_media b JOIN posts p ON p.id=b.post_id WHERE b.media_id=m.id AND p.status IN ('pending','rejected','visible','hidden') AND (p.status IN ('pending','rejected') OR p.expires_at IS NULL OR p.expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comment_media b JOIN comments c ON c.id=b.comment_id JOIN posts p ON p.id=c.post_id WHERE b.media_id=m.id AND c.status IN ('pending','rejected','visible','hidden') AND (c.status IN ('pending','rejected') OR c.expires_at IS NULL OR c.expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND p.scope='public' AND p.status='visible' AND p.expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )

SELECT p.id,p.author_principal_id,p.display_mode,CASE WHEN p.display_mode='account' THEN pr.account_id END AS author_account_id,CASE WHEN p.display_mode='account' THEN COALESCE((SELECT nickname FROM profiles WHERE account_id=pr.account_id AND visibility='public' AND moderation_status='approved' LIMIT 1),'Youren用户') END AS author_nickname,p.title,p.body,p.category,p.region_code,p.status,p.published_at,p.expires_at,p.version FROM posts p LEFT JOIN principals pr ON pr.id=p.author_principal_id WHERE p.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF p

SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN c.display_mode='account' THEN pr.account_id END AS author_account_id,CASE WHEN c.display_mode='account' THEN COALESCE((SELECT nickname FROM profiles WHERE account_id=pr.account_id AND visibility='public' AND moderation_status='approved' LIMIT 1),'Youren用户') END AS author_nickname FROM comments c LEFT JOIN principals pr ON pr.id=c.author_principal_id WHERE c.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF c
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET status=#{status},published_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='visible' THEN COALESCE(published_at,#{now}) ELSE published_at END,expires_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='visible' THEN COALESCE(expires_at,#{now} + INTERVAL '1 year') ELSE expires_at END,deleted_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='deleted' THEN #{now} ELSE deleted_at END,version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('deleted','expired') AND (#{status}<>'visible' OR expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>#{now})

UPDATE comments SET status=#{status},published_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='visible' THEN COALESCE(published_at,#{now}) ELSE published_at END,expires_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='visible' THEN COALESCE(expires_at,#{now} + INTERVAL '1 year') ELSE expires_at END,deleted_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='deleted' THEN #{now} ELSE deleted_at END,version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('deleted','expired') AND (#{status}<>'visible' OR expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>#{now})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moderation_actions(id,report_id,admin_id,target_type,post_id,comment_id,action,reason,expected_version) VALUES(#{id},#{reportId},#{adminId},#{targetType},CASE WHEN #{targetType}='post' THEN #{targetId} END,CASE WHEN #{targetType}='comment' THEN #{targetId} END,#{action},#{reason},#{expectedVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT id,admin_id,target_type,COALESCE(post_id,comment_id) AS target_id,action,reason,created_at FROM moderation_actions WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_records(actor_key,method,route_key,key,request_hash,status,resource_type,resource_id,response_code,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(#{actor},'POST',#{route},#{key},#{hash},'completed','moderation_action',#{id},201,#{now},#{now},#{expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT(actor_key,method,route_key,key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,resource_id,expires_at FROM idempotency_records WHERE actor_key=#{actor} AND method='POST' AND route_key=#{route} AND key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM idempotency_records WHERE actor_key=#{actor} AND method='POST' AND route_key=#{route} AND key=#{key})
